title: A Measure-Theoretic Derivation of Zadeh Fuzzy Logic
summary: Zadeh fuzzy logic is normally introduced by assigning scalar membership degrees and postulating standard complement, minimum conjunction, and maximum disjunction. We derive this calculus from a strictly positive atomless normalized Boolean measure algebra. Equality of measure sends Boolean complement uniquely to $1-x$, but it cannot send meet to a single-valued operation: the exact scalar image of conjunction is the overlap interval $[(x+y-1)^+,\min\{x,y\}]$. We quantify the information lost under scalarization, prove that no nontrivial measure-preserving compression can retain meet, and…
